verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents real 2FA plus account lock and optional Registry Lock (dynadot-docs-29), giving a defensible account layer, but there is no evidence of scoped/least-privilege API credentials or IP allowlisting for API access anywhere in the docs or API reference. A prior security incident (dynadot-comm-1) also shows account compromise risk despite these controls. missing for 10: scoped API credential/permission controls, IP allowlisting for API access, independent confirmation these controls hold up under attack.
